segment.description: Brimstone Creek, a Scott County tributary of the New River in the Big South Fork subbasin of the Cumberland Plateau; no active USGS gauge and no documented access or fishery program.
segment.boundaries: Full named length of Brimstone Creek in Scott County to its confluence with the New River (HUC 05130104); historic USGS 03408200 'Brimstone Creek near Robbins' (36.3454, -84.5394, drainage 48.7 sq mi) is the only on-creek station.

holdover.detail: No holdover or trout evidence of any kind located for this creek.

wildPopulation.detail: No fish survey, trout record, or fishery documentation located. Program-level absence is documented: no row in TWRA's 2026 trout stocking schedule, not on TWRA's wild-trout-stream list, and the NPS Big South Fork fishing page does not cover this creek. The only USGS station (03408200, near Robbins) holds just 1965-1983-era discrete field samples with no continuous record.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: No agency temperature, fishery, or survey record exists for this small New River tributary; only its absence from TWRA trout programs is documented.
